items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: I got this idea from my friend Owen Dodson... Miles Davis probably has provided you with some. [INTERVIEWEE] Miles was always funny... when I first met Miles, Davis... We were standing in the parking lot waiting for the car... Miles and I were standing waiting for our car

ctx.x: I got this idea from my friend Owen Dodson (Louts?) and the poet, playwright who is writing a fascinating book which he calls "The Gossip Book". And it's filled with absolutely marvellous stories, quoted anecdotes, about the people from the world of art. And I'm wondering if you were to write such a book what some of your favorite anecdotes might be that you would include. Can you think of some stories that you just love? About very funny things that happened along the way? There must have been some. Miles Davis…
Miles was always funny. I can't ever think of anything that he would say except that he was funny.
It's not just a matter of what he might just say as such, but I think that there are ( ?).

items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Well when somebody asks Miles one like that he tells them that that's a dumb question.

ctx.x: Well when somebody asks Miles one like that he tells them that that's a dumb question. (LAUGHTER). So as a result, he gets bad press.
I myself have a very negative view of newspaper reporters in general. And after hearing the stupid questions that they ask when you are observing them on television.....
